name: Farren's Proof
summary: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle sends Alliance recruits along Southshore's coast to prove his patrol's success. Marshal Redpath wants evidence that the murlocs have been cleared from the Western Strand.

sections.title: A Grudging Request
sections.body: After the first coastal sweeps in Down the Coast, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle faces scrutiny from Marshal Redpath and Southshore's leaders. Farren claims the local murlocs have been cleared, but his superiors want proof. He leaves the grim work to wandering Alliance adventurers and sends them back to the shore for evidence of the kills.

sections.title: Grisly Evidence
sections.body: The Western Strand lies west of Southshore, where coastal murlocs live along the shallows. Farren asks for ten severed murloc heads to satisfy the garrison's officers. He detests the creatures and says their repulsive sight and smell have ruined his appetite for Southshore's chief export and staple food.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is an Alliance officer stationed in Southshore. He wants to report success to his superiors and leaves the violent, filthy work of shoreline security to adventurers.

faq.q: Why does Farren need severed murloc heads?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath and Southshore's officials wanted physical proof of dead murlocs before accepting reports that the Western Strand had been cleared.
The murlocs live along the Western Strand, west of Southshore, toward the border of Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What happens after turning in Farren's Proof?
faq.answer: Farren asks you to report the murloc deaths to Marshal Redpath. After accepting the proof, Redpath turns his attention to threats on the Eastern Strand and later passes along Stormwind's reassignment orders for Farren.

faq.q: Why is Farren disgusted by the murlocs?
faq.answer: Farren finds walking, bipedal fish repulsive. Handling their cold, slimy remains has put him off eating fish, making life in Southshore's fishing community miserable.
Marshal Redpath commands Southshore's town defenses. He holds junior officers like Farren Orinelle accountable for regional security.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you help secure Southshore's coast against native predators, leaving the outpost to focus on threats from the Syndicate and the Horde.
As a cook in Southshore, you may find Farren's aversion to seafood baffling. Fighting along the beach can also yield spare raw catches.
